title: eugenia miqueliana
intro: Eugenia miqueliana, commonly known as the mountain apple or red stawberry guava, is a species of flowering plant in the myrtle family, native to the Philippines. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Eugenia miqueliana is also said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, alleviating digestive issues, and soothing respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
